title: Guardrail HTTP adapter request v1
description: The body the LLM gateway POSTs to a guardrail http detector URL (ADR-0043 decision 1). Mirrors AdapterRequest in services/elitea-llm-gateway/internal/guardrail/httpadapter.go. Content is the text the detector inspects: the request messages (stage input) or the model answer (stage output). On a streamed answer the gateway sends one request per evaluated window: the held text plus up to one window of text already released.
